'''Selanno''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Quesh war]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]], he was stationed at the [[Imperial Garrison (Quesh)|Imperial Garrison]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Selanno appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Specialty Goods vendor for Imperial players on Quesh.<ref name="TOR" />
